ITEM 1 | Pale cream-to-tan grain mass with fine granular texture, loosely clumped and crumbly, scattered with small brown bits and tiny darker flecks, sitting on the left-center of the plate; covers roughly 20% of plate area, about 5 cm tall at the mound | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark green wilted leafy greens (spinach-like), glossy and limp with slight moisture sheen, with thin pale stems, spread across the right-center and lower part of the plate covering roughly 30% of plate area, about 1.5 cm thick in clumps | 85
ITEM 3 | Thin, flat, crisp-looking strip of reddish-brown cooked meat with darker browned edges and slight translucency, lying diagonally over the greens on the right side, about 15 cm long and 2 cm wide | 15
ITEM 4 | Thin matchstick-cut orange carrot shreds, bright orange with slightly glossy surface, scattered across the rice and greens, roughly 4 cm long each, covering about 3% of plate area and under 0.5 cm tall | 6
ITEM 5 | Small scattered brown crumbs and bits, dark brown with dry texture, sprinkled near the rice and on the rim, each under 1 cm across | 2
